title: when Orca reports no folder for the terminal and the dialog shows, the launch is refused as 'untrusted folder (unknown)'
source: cli/jitso/trust.test.ts: 'no folder at all is never trusted'
intended: TS-ODDITIES L4 (owner decision, defect N-22): the folder Orca reports is checked on every launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L4, owner decision, defect N-22). The launch compares the folder Orca reports with the worktrees of the repo right after terminal create, before the idle wait, so a refused launch calls only terminal create and terminal close, sends no key and writes no registry line. The stderr text keeps its prefix and tail. The TS binary compares the folder only when the trust dialog shows, and only after the idle wait and a screen read, so it calls terminal wait and terminal read first.
